title: Sprinkling for random regular graphs and Kim-Vu's sandwich conjecture
summary: We show that the uniform random $d$-regular graph model on $n$ vertices is, in total variation distance, asymptotically close to the union of $d$ uniformly random edge-disjoint perfect matchings, provided that $n$ is even and $ω(1) = d \leq n^{1/10}$. This confirms a conjecture by Hollom, Lichev, Mond, Portier, and Wang for this range of parameters. This result has a couple of interesting consequences.
